caption: The drawing depicts a natural scene composed of various plants, flowers, animals, and insects. In the center, there is a tree with an upward-curving trunk and green leaves, from which a large pink and red flower hangs. To the left of the tree is a brown deer with antlers, standing on green grass. Further left, there are several tall green plants with round, yellow-green flower clusters, and at the far left, there is a reddish-brown low animal, possibly a dog, lying on the grass with pink flowers scattered nearby. On the right side of the tree, there is a large purple and blue flower with a yellow center, and elongated, curved blue leaves. The foreground consists of a varied landscape with different shades of green hills, scattered red and pink flowers, and blades of grass. Above, near the top left corner, a yellow-green butterfly with black markings flies, and in the top right, a blue butterfly is also present. The entire composition is rendered in colored embroidery on a beige fabric background that shows stitching marks along the edges.
title: Embroidery
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
